title: Manager, Solutions Engineering
description:
At Algolia , we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests - four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

At Algolia , we are passionate about helping developers and product teams connect their users with what matters most, in milliseconds. Algolia provides the industry's most powerful search and discovery SaaS platform, driving richer engagement and success for over 17,000 companies worldwide.
Algolia is looking for a Solutions Engineering Manager to lead and grow our AMER Solutions Engineer (SE) team, covering the US, supporting Commercial & SMB SEs. Our SEs collaborate with Algolia users to understand their business challenges, architect and develop solutions, and serve as deep subject matter experts on Algolia 's products and services, helping our prospects, customers, and users solve real-world problems through code, advice, and content.
Rolling up to the Director, Solutions Engineering as part of SE leadership, you will lead a team of approximately 5 Solutions Engineers, with direct accountability for technical wins, deal-level coaching, ramp of new hires, and partnership with Sales, Customer Success, and Product leaders across AMER. You will be the technical leader closest to our customers in the region, both internally and externally, and a critical part of how we continue to scale Solutions Engineering across AMER.
This is the right role for a hands-on technical leader who balances team development, customer-facing presence, and cross-functional execution. The ideal candidate combines a solid mix of management and business experience with technical knowledge, a passion for data driven leadership, and a coaching mindset, who is known for developing people, not just closing deals.
YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF

• Leading approximately 5 Solutions Engineers covering Commercial, Enterprise, and Strategic accounts across AMER

• Developing your SEs to facilitate technical storytelling and drive the narrative during our pre-sales cycle

• Owning accountability for all aspects of the technical evaluation across AMER deals - starting in the discovery stage (SS2), progressing through evaluation (SS3), and all the way to business close

• Partnering with the regional Sales leader and AEs in AMER to align SE coverage, prioritize pursuits, and build joint pipeline and account strategy

• Coaching individual SEs on consultative selling; uncovering customer business outcomes and mapping Algolia capabilities to quantifiable ROI

• Championing the adoption of AI to drive SE team productivity, coaching your SE's on AI coding tools, automated demo and PoC generation, and AI assisted discovery and solution design to accelerate ramp, improve deal velocity, and free SE capacity for high-judgment work

• Lead the SE team's adoption of AI, including coaching on AI coding tools and AI-assisted discovery, solution design, and demo generation, to improve deal velocity and elevate SE capacity toward high-judgment work

• Strategizing on driving business objectives through our Value Engineering process, which leverages real quantitative customer data

• Partnering with our Demo Engineering team to build out compelling examples that showcase what our technology has to offer and prove out ROI

• Supporting quarterly quota attainment by achieving technical wins on net new business in the region

• Implementing best practices and data-driven programs to improve win rates, sales cycle, and product adoption, and to lift the efficiency of our revenue support functions

title: Applied AI/ML Engineer (Agents)
description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

Due to rapid growth in our core AI capabilities, we are seeking an experienced Applied AI/ML Engineer (Agents) to design and build the intelligent agents that power our autonomous materials discovery engine.

YOUR IMPACT

You will be instrumental in developing the "artificial brain" of our agentic materials discovery engine. This is responsible for orchestrating complex, closed-loop scientific workflows, autonomously making decisions, running simulations, and driving experimental campaigns to find breakthrough materials faster than ever before.

Your work will directly accelerate CuspAI’s path to finding solutions for global sustainability challenges.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Agentic systems

- Design the agentic framework that powers our platform to discover new materials. This includes spanning dynamic, multi-stage simulation workflows from literature-grounded hypothesis generation through to computational and experimental validation

- Build the integration that connects agents to ML models, simulation engines, databases, and heterogeneous compute backends

- Design pipelines that let agents autonomously plan, schedule, execute, and interpret computational tasks at scale and over long periods of time

- Use expert annotations from the Chemistry team to drive targeted improvements in agent planning, retrieval, and decision-making

- Create evaluations to measure the effectiveness of agents

Experimental design

- Build agents that perform experimental design - applying Bayesian optimization, active learning, or related sequential decision-making methods to decide what to compute or measure next, and to balance exploration and exploitation across long-running discovery campaigns

- Help close the loop between simulation and physical experiments so that outcomes become durable knowledge - feeding back into what agents know and how their models reason - compounding across campaigns.

- Develop strategies for multi-fidelity and multi-objective decision-making, where agents must trade off cost, time, and uncertainty across simulations and physical experiments

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

- Work closely with Chemists, Materials Scientists, and the rest of the Agent team to co-develop our core orchestration intelligence

- Work on customer projects and implement the direct needs required for these projects

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

- You are someone who gets excited about the opportunity to enable scientists to work on world changing challenges in this domain, with a personal interest in the potential applications of the technology that CuspAI is building.

- Proficiency in the modern ML ecosystem such as PyTorch or JAX, with experience taking ML-driven systems from prototype to production

- Strong software engineering skills (building systems at scale in a production environment): testing, modular design, CI/CD, and scalable ML operations in production environments

description:

nesto is a Canadian fintech founded in Montreal in 2018. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish. We started as a digital broker using technology to bring transparency to the mortgage process, then built Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online mortgage lending platform, where qualified mortgage experts are backed by advanced technology. At nesto, we build the technology that makes mortgages in Canada faster, simpler, and more transparent, and we ship at real speed.
We've since grown into a full mortgage ecosystem, serving large financial institutions across Canada as a B2B partner. Our first B2B product launched in 2022 with IG Wealth Management. In 2024, nesto acquired CMLS Group, forming the nesto Group (nesto, CMLS, and its subsidiary brand Intellifi). We now have 1,300 employees across 12 offices nationwide and $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgage assets under administration.

Our growth means new development teams, and every team includes a Senior QA Automation Developer (I or II) as part of its core structure. • Collaborate with Staff QA Automation Developers to improve processes and QA practices across the organization.

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for key projects, for example when we integrate new partners/clients.

• Review and execute manual test cases and scripts for features under development using test management/tracking tools to provide feedback on automation suitability to the project team.

• Manually validate features based on test plans and integrate those scenarios into the automated regression test suite.

What you bring

• 5+ years of QA experience testing SaaS or cloud applications, with a deep understanding of the full SDLC and how quality engineering fits into the development process.

• 2+ years of hands-on automation framework experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar, with a proven ability to author, maintain, and scale end-to-end (E2E) test suites.

• An automation-first mindset, with a track record of prioritizing automated coverage over manual-only QA and building reliability into the CI/CD pipeline.

• Full-stack testing capability across UI and API layers, including experience with tools like Postman for API validation, ensuring comprehensive coverage

description:

Scope of Work

• Review visual feedback, identify deviations from requirements, and make targeted corrections to maintain annotation quality at scale.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO - Strategic & Operational Partner
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a high-leverage Executive Assistant to act as a strategic right hand to our CEO. This is not a typical administrative position. Beyond handling calendar management and travel coordination in a fast-paced, chaotic environment, you will play an active role in driving operational efficiency.

We need a clear-thinking, proactive problem solver who can jump right in without needing hand-holding. You will analyze data, build reports, identify operational gaps, and bring solutions to the table before issues arise.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Operations & Gatekeeping

• Act as the primary point of contact and buffer for the CEO, managing internal and external communications with tact and judgment.

• Maintain complete situational awareness of the CEO’s priorities, deadlines, and ongoing projects.

• Manage complex, fluid calendars across multiple time zones, adjusting dynamically to continuous travel schedule changes.

• Handle seamless international travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics.

2. Data Analysis & Business Intelligence

• Gather data across departments to create clear, actionable executive reports, dashboards, and presentations.

• Continuously audit workflows and metrics to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas for process improvement.

• Conduct research and synthesize complex information into quick, digestible briefs for decision-making.

3. Financial & Administrative Support

• Assist with financial tracking, expense management, budget auditing, and financial reporting.

• Monitor key financial indicators and track cross-departmental deliverables to ensure projects remain on budget and on schedule.

• Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Turnkey Capability: Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief Of Staff, Business Operations Manager, or Strategic Coordinator. You can drop into a fast-moving environment on Day 1 without requiring extensive training.

• High IQ & Analytical Thinking: Exceptional logic and problem-solving ability. You don't just report data; you understand what the numbers mean and recommend action.

• Proactive & Autonomous: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and actively look for ways to lighten the CEO's operational load.

• Chaos Tolerance: High adaptability, mental resilience, and composure in fast-changing, high-pressure environments.

• Financial Literacy: Comfort with numbers, spreadsheets, financial statements, and basic business finance principles.

• Time Zone Agility: Willingness and technical setup to work asynchronously and align with the CEO’s shifting global schedule.

• Tech Savvy: Advanced proficiency in modern workspace tools (e.g., Claude, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Excel/Google Sheets, project management platforms).

title: Principal Analog Design Engineer
description:
About TylSemi, Inc.
The Opportunity
The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?
That's what we solve. TylSemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.
This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path.
Why Now
The Market Window
The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:
• Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
• Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
• IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.
Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing.
Culture & Team: How We Work
No Politics, No Bureaucracy
There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.
• If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.
• No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.
Remote-Friendly, Global Team
• US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
• India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore
Move Fast, Ship Real Products
We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.
This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.
What We Value

title: Technical Account Manager

description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes-from emerging brands to Fortune 500s-use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Customs Matters More Than Ever

International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis-sparked by Trump-era tariffs-has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.

That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.

The opportunity: 

Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes-they simply can’t adapt fast enough.

Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.

Things we ❤️

• Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way

• Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows

• Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform

• Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases

You will:

• Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.

• Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.

• Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.

• Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)

• Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.

• Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.

• Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.

• Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.

• Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.

You should have:

• ≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.

• A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.

• The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.

• A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.

• A desire to develop your tooling reper

title: Design Director
description:
About this Role
We're looking for a Design Director to lead design excellence across Valerie's Centre of Excellence. You'll own the visual identity and design systems for every brand in our portfolio, ensuring each one has a distinctive, high-quality look and a design system capable of producing exceptional work at speed and scale. You'll lead, develop, and mentor Valerie's design team across brand, still, motion, digital, and e-commerce design.
You'll connect brand strategy, GTM direction, Growth Masters, and Creative Experiments into visual worlds and design systems that help brands grow - from building a new brand from scratch to producing high-volume, hardworking assets across e-commerce, paid, social, and CRM. Success in this role isn't measured by how many assets are produced; it's measured by how distinctive our brands look, how effectively design drives commercial results, and how well the team scales quality without slowing down.
You could be a great fit if...
• You naturally balance a strong aesthetic point of view with the discipline needed to scale design across many brands.
• You enjoy translating positioning, GTM strategy, and creative platforms into clear, distinctive visual direction.
• You know how brand worlds need to flex across e-commerce, paid, social, CRM, and marketplaces without losing coherence.
• You thrive on building design systems, templates, and working standards that let teams move fast without compromising quality.
• You enjoy leading and mentoring designers, giving direction that develops people rather than just correcting their work.
• You proactively use performance data to sharpen design decisions rather than treating creative as purely subjective.
• You can confidently raise the bar on work before it reaches founders, holding a high standard of craft.
• You enjoy building playbooks and repeatable systems that make multiple brands and teams better, rather than just producing one-off assets.
• You're comfortable designing for global audiences and understand how visual language shifts across markets like North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand.
Requirements
• 8-10+ years of experience in Design, Art Direction, or Design Direction within advertising, branding, digital, or integrated agencies and/or high-growth consumer brands.
• Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary design teams.
• An exceptional portfolio demonstrating a clear aesthetic point of view across brand identity, digital, e-commerce, campaigns, and social.
• Proven experience building brands and visual worlds from the ground up.
• Experience translating brand worlds into high-quality, high-volume asset production.
• Strong understanding of e-commerce, DTC, and digital marketing environments.
• Strong understanding of still and motion design, with the ability to direct multidisciplinary creative talent.
• Advanced capability across Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
• Highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using Canva within scalable brand systems.
• Experience working across multiple brands simultaneously.
Bonus Points
• Experience working with SMEs, start-ups, or entrepreneurial/high-growth consumer businesses.
• Strong experience in presentation and deck design.
• Experience working across key markets - North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand - with strong awareness of cultural and aesthetic differences.
• Experience extending brand worlds into packaging, retail, POS, or physical experiences.
• Familiarity with using AI to accelerate design development, adaptation, and production without replacing craft or judgement.
• Experience building reusable design systems, prompts, or templates that can be embedded into AI-driven workflows.
You probably shouldn't apply if...
• You prefer producing individual assets over building the systems that let a whole team produce them.
• You see design as a purely aesthetic exerc

We are actively searching for a Graphics & Marketing Coordinator (GMC) to add to our team. If you are amazing at multi-tasking, thrive while working independently, learn new technology quickly, and are creative and design-savvy, we want to hear from you!
We are excited to offer a flexible, remote-first work environment. Our employees work remotely across the country.
About Impact
Founded in 2006, we are an Association Management Company (AMC) that specializes in managing medium-sized associations led by volunteers. Our clients are associations in a wide variety of industries and range from local chapters to international organizations and professional societies. Learn more about us at ImpactAMC.com.
About this role
The primary job of a Graphics & Marketing Coordinator (GMC) is to produce high-quality design materials in support of the brand, communication strategies, and promotional efforts for both Impact and its clients. The GMC is also responsible for fulfilling a limited scope of marketing operations for their assigned Impact clients, such as managing digital content, event promotion, and ensuring consistent brand messaging across all channels.
Job duties include, but are not limited to:

• Manage the intake, prioritization, execution, and timely delivery of graphic design requests.

• Coordinate the production and distribution of print and digital collateral, including: magazines, flyers, brochures, logos, pamphlets, social media images, etc. This includes working closely with internal teams and external vendors to ensure designs are accurate, brand-aligned and delivered on time. • Coordinate marketing content calendars and publish content across the client’s platforms. Monitor and report out on engagement on these platforms.

• Update and maintain client websites with marketing content, event information, and publications.

• Support branding efforts by ensuring consistent voice and visual identity across all communications.

• General administrative duties to support marketing-related activities completed on behalf of clients.

• Proactively keep their client teams up to date on work, priorities, and progress.

• Regularly update procedures and maintain accurate documentation for all work they complete.

Offered Pay Range: $21-$27/hour
Offered pay will be within the listed range and based on candidate work experience and experience working in the association industry and multi-client environments. Other factors considered include complementary skills or industries that are akin to Impact's, as well as certifications within the association/AMC industry.
Requirements
To be considered for the GMC role, individuals must possess the following (with few exceptions):

• Minimum of 2 years of graphic design and/or marketing experience

• Advanced in Adobe Creative Cloud apps, particularly InDesign

• Advanced in Canva and similar tools

• Proficient with email marketing platforms and social media management tools

• Able to be consistently available during Impact’s core work hours: 9:00am - 3:00pm Central Time.

• Preferred:

• Proficient with Association Management Systems (Wild Apricot, YourMembership, MemberClicks)

• Experience working with nonprofit organizations/associations

description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay-and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler-for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

Why you should join Contentsquare

- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
- Lifestyle allowance
- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

- And more benefits tailored to each country
 
Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
 
Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. 
 
Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.
 
Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Vendor Manager
description:
Vendor / Category Manager - Deliveroo Hop UAE

Deliveroo Hop is Deliveroo's 24/7 supermarket - a digital-only experience that allows customers to shop online for all of their groceries, ingredients, household essentials & more, on-demand, and delivered to them in minutes.

Role Overview:

As Vendor / Category Manager, you will be responsible for the performance of a category within Deliveroo Hop. Working closely with the Vendor Management Lead, you will play a key role in shaping the category strategy through range selection, sourcing, pricing, cost and contract negotiations, promotions, merchandising and marketing campaigns, as well as managing the vendors within that category. We are looking for a candidate with a strong commercial mindset focused on driving growth and creative approach to problem solving.

You will be based in our Dubai office (DIFC), where we operate on a hybrid model (three days a week working in the office), and this role will report to the Senior Vendor Manager.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Category Management

- Support the Vendor Management Lead in selecting a great range of products and set pricing, as per selection and pricing principles and in line with the Deliveroo Hop CVP;

- Ensure the right SKUs are nominated for effective and efficient promotional campaigns and events;

- Monitoring SKU performance and optimising the range;

- Deep dive category performance vs plan and define and execute plans to drive improvement and sustainable growth;

Vendor Management

- Develop and manage relationships with local and international grocery suppliers;

- Negotiate contracts and agreements with vendors to ensure favourable terms and service levels;

- Analyse vendor performance and take corrective actions to improve service and quality.

- Manage vendor compliance and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.

- Work closely with the in-stock team to source new products and maintain inventory levels.

- Resolve vendor-related issues and disputes and escalations including invoice, payment and account reconciliation with the vendors.

- Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new vendor & range opportunities.

- Drive media spend with vendors on the platform to promote products and enhance visibility.

Requirements

- 3+ years experience in vendor/category management or buying function (grocery experience would be a benefit but not requirement);

- An analytical and problem-solving mindset used to evaluate vendor and category performance and identify areas for improvement.

- Good negotiation skills and the ability to build strong partnerships with vendors;

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with internal teams and resolve vendor-related issues.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt to changing market dynamics;

- A proactive and results-driven approach to vendor management and procurement;

- Good knowledge of working on spreadsheets (Excel / Gsheets).

Desirable requirements

- Experience in international FMCG sourcing and sourcing of fresh categories to cater to diversity of offerings is a bonus.

- Knowledge of BI and data analytic tools like SQL, Tableau, Power BI, etc would be an added advantage.

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Program Manager
description:
NETGEAR is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Program Manager to lead cross-functional security initiatives across products, cloud services, enterprise systems, and operations. This role translates cybersecurity strategy into execution, drives stakeholder alignment, and ensures risks and priorities are effectively managed.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage cybersecurity programs across product security, enterprise security, vulnerability management, cloud security, compliance, certifications, and incident readiness.

- Own program roadmaps, priorities, schedules, budgets, dependencies, risks, and delivery.

- Facilitate cybersecurity incident response, coordinating stakeholders, actions, communications, and post-incident follow-up.

- Define, develop, and track KPIs, dashboards, and executive reporting to measure security posture, risk, remediation, and program effectiveness.

- Identify blockers and material risks, drive resolution, and escalate issues requiring leadership attention.

- Partner with engineering, IT, legal, privacy, compliance, and business teams to drive risk remediation and security improvements.

- Coordinate security assessments, audits, certifications, penetration tests, bug bounties, and remediation activities.

- Manage security vendors and third-party engagements, including scope, deliverables, performance, and issue resolution.

- Track emerging risks and regulatory requirements and strengthen security-by-design practices.

- Leverage AI and automation to improve program execution, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technical program management, or related fields, including leading complex security programs.

- Strong knowledge of security risk management, incident response, product and cloud security, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.

- Experience with security metrics, dashboards, executive reporting, vendor management, and third-party assessments.

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead cross-functional teams, manage escalations, and drive outcomes.

- Excellent communication, analytical, prioritization, and executive presentation skills.

- Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or related discipline; CISSP, CISM, PMP, or similar certification preferred.

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.  

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

- The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

- Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

- A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

- Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

- Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

- A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole cour

title: Chief Actuary
description:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions-from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.
As a Chief Actuary, you will:

• Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.

• Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure.

• Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

description:
Job Title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate Sponsor-dedicated
Job Location: Athens, Greece
Job Location Type: Home-based

Job Overview
Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.
Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and Good Clinical Practice.
• Work with sites to adapt, drive, and track subject recruitment plan in line with project needs to enhance predictability.
• Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.
• Evaluate the quality and integrity of study site practices related to the proper conduct of the protocol and adherence to applicable regulations. Escalate quality issues as appropriate.
• Manage the progress of assigned studies by tracking regulatory submissions and approvals, recruitment and enrollment, case report form (CRF) completion and submission, and data query generation and resolution. May support start-up phase.
• Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and local regulatory requirements.
• Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
• Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
• If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.
• If applicable, may be accountable for site financial management according to executed clinical trial agreement and retrieve invoices according to local requirement.
Qualifications
• High School Diploma or equivalent Degree in scientific discipline or health care preferred.
• Requires at least 2 years of year of on-site monitoring experience.
• Equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
• Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements.
• i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
• Good therapeutic and protocol knowledge as provided in company training.
• Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and use of a laptop computer and iPhone and iPad (where applicable).
• Written and verbal communication skills including good command of Greek and English language.
• Organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Effective time and financial management skills.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.

This role is responsible for the design, development, configuration, implementation, and ongoing optimization of our ServiceNow Software Asset Management (SAM) Pro module. The successful candidate will leverage their deep understanding of the ServiceNow platform and SAM best practices to ensure accurate license positions, drive cost savings, enhance compliance, and streamline our software lifecycle processes.
This is a hands-on technical role that requires strong development capabilities within the ServiceNow platform, particularly with SAM Pro, combined with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Responsibilities:
ServiceNow SAM Pro Development & Configuration:

• Design, develop, configure, and customize the ServiceNow SAM Pro module, including Software Models, Entitlements, Discovery Models, Software Installations, Contracts, and License Positions while adhering to platform best practices.

• Implement and maintain Publisher Packs (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe, IBM, VMWare, Salesforce) within SAM Pro.

• Develop and enhance SAM Pro workflows, business rules, client scripts, script includes, UI policies, and data policies.

• Configure and optimize Discovery Sources (e.g., MECM, AD, Tanium, ServiceNow Discovery) to feed accurate software installation data into SAM Pro.

• Develop custom integrations between SAM Pro and other systems (e.g., Procurement, HR, CMDB, Finance, external discovery tools) using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other integration methods.

• Create and maintain advanced reports, dashboards, and performance analytics within SAM Pro to provide actionable insights into software consumption and compliance.

Software Asset Management Optimization:

• Drive the normalization and reconciliation processes within SAM Pro to ensure accurate software identification and license compliance.

• Identify opportunities for software harvesting, optimization, and cost avoidance/savings through effective use of SAM Pro features (e.g., downgrade rights, unallocated licenses).

• Support the implementation of process, data and controls necessary for the platform to become an Accountable Property System of Record (APSR)

• Assist in defining and utilizing SAM administration and configuration policies and procedures within the ServiceNow platform.

System Maintenance & Support:

• Perform regular health checks, performance tuning, and troubleshooting of the SAM Pro module.

• Support ServiceNow platform upgrades and ensure SAM Pro functionality is maintained including operability of customizations and configurations.

• Collaborate with IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Security teams to ensure data integrity and system stability.

• Provide expert-level support and guidance to SAM analysts and other stakeholders.

Documentation & Collaboration:

• Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, configuration guides, and process flows.

• Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to overall development best practices.

• Provide training and knowledge transfer to end-users and junior team members.

title: Account Executive
description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?
At Trader Interactive , we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.
When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.
What We Offer

• An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

• The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 2,500 team members worldwide, and our CAR Group Tour means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

• Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

• Using the consultative sales approach, present and deliver sustainable digital marketing/advertising solutions to dealers in person and virtually.

• Consistently achieve goals and objectives for revenue, retention, new product sales and account ownership, lead by example to foster high standards within your respective team.

• Deliver in person/virtual quarterly business reviews with recommendations for existing dealer customers.

• Implement an organized and effective account and territory target revenue plan, including sales pipeline and forecasting management and sales account activity documentation in Salesforce.

What We’re Looking For

• 2+ years of B2B digital marketing/advertising sales experience, with a proven track record of success in maintaining and growing existing clients.

• Commitment to evaluating and improving your sales funnel performance (Activity, Conversion, Yield).

• Excellent discovery, presentation, communication and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency with sales software, particularly Salesforce (CRM) systems, Gong, GeoPoint etc.

• Ability to analyze sales/market data and translate into actionable insight.

• Positive attitude, Self-motivated, organized and able to work independently and in team environments.

• Comfortable leading a meeting with a marketing team/departments decision makers.

• Travel limited to attend trade shows and training/sales events.

Bonus Points:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or related field.

• Sold within Commercial, Recreational, or Auto digital sales.

• Digital sales/media accreditations (IAB, Google Ads & Analytics, Meta).

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.
TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity.

title: Group Tax Manager
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Tax Team 👋

Trainline is a FTSE 250 global travel tech business, and our Tax team plays a central role in how we manage our financial responsibilities across the Group. Since our Group Head of Tax joined, we have been on an exciting journey - building out a dynamic in-house tax function and transitioning from a fully outsourced model to a proactive, value-adding internal advisory and compliance capability. With a clear roadmap in place and an enthusiastic Senior Tax Analyst already embedded in the team, this is a genuinely compelling moment to join and help shape the next chapter of what our tax function can be.

As Group Tax Manager, you will report directly to the Group Head of Tax and take real ownership across the full breadth of our tax obligations - spanning corporation tax, VAT, employment taxes, and transfer pricing across our UK and European entities. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, HR Operations, Legal, and Treasury, acting as a key bridge between the tax function and the wider business, whilst also playing an active role in supporting the professional development of the Senior Tax Analyst and managing relationships with external advisors and auditors.

In this role as the Group Tax Manager, you will...🚄

- Own the management of all compliance tax matters across the Group's UK and European entities (UK, France, Italy, Spain, and Belgium), including corporation tax, VAT, and employment taxes, working with external advisors to ensure accurate and timely submissions across all jurisdictions.

- Lead the tax accounting function end-to-end, including preparation of tax disclosures in statutory accounts, management of Group audit provision corporation tax calculations, and ownership of tax journals and postings using Microsoft D365 - acting as the bridge between tax and finance.

- Drive the budgeting and forecasting of corporation taxes, leveraging forecasting software (Pigment) and automating calculations where possible, whilst managing Quarterly Instalment Payments and cash tax positions in collaboration with the Finance and Treasury teams.

- Review and manage UK and EU VAT return submissions via Making Tax Digital software, and oversee Operational Transfer Pricing across Group entities, ensuring intercompany agreements are maintained and invoicing is operating as expected.

- Lead the management of R&D tax relief claims across Group jurisdictions, working closely with technical teams and external advisors to ensure submissions are accurate and timely.

- Champion tax process improvement across the business, identifying automation opportunities, communicating best practices, and delivering training to the wider team to embed lasting change.

- Manage tax governance for the Group, including the CCO risk register, the SAO annual process, tax accounting controls, and process documentation, ensuring a well-governed and audit-ready function.

- Support the Group Head of Tax on ad-hoc res

Fire Sprinkler Design Engineer
description:
Fire Sprinkler Design Engineer - Independent Contractor (Ukraine)

Location: Ukraine, Remote
Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor Agreement for Provision of Services (Long-Term)

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced Fire Sprinkler Design Engineer for a long-term independent contractor engagement.

This is an ongoing contractual engagement with a US-based company and is not limited to a single project. The role involves continuous collaboration across multiple mission-critical projects, based on business needs.

You will provide services as an independent, self-employed professional under a formal independent contractor agreement.

How to Apply: Interested candidates should submit their resume in English detailing their relevant experience.

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled Fire Sprinkler Design Engineer to support the design and coordination of fire sprinkler and suppression systems for cutting-edge data center projects across the U.S.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, modeling, and coordinating fire sprinkler systems, including wet, dry, pre-action, and deluge systems . You will prepare hydraulic calculations, sprinkler layouts, engineering documentation, and detailed designs while ensuring compliance with applicable fire protection codes and standards.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from schematic design through detailed design and execution.

Strong technical expertise in sprinkler system design, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills are essential.

What We Offer

• Experience in a high-tech industry completing work for an international company

• Unique, cutting-edge data center projects

• Dynamic work partnering with a team of professionals focused on engineering

• Competitive hourly rate

• Ability to collaborate remotely

• Supportive dynamic environment

• English classes made available

• Using BIM tools to model and coordinate fire sprinkler systems with other disciplines; hands-on Autodesk Revit experience is a must

• Designing fire sprinkler and suppression systems, including wet, dry, pre-action, and deluge systems

• Developing sprinkler layouts and detailed fire protection designs for mission-critical facilities

• Preparing hydraulic calculations and other engineering calculations required for sprinkler system design

• Selecting and laying out sprinkler heads, piping, valves, and associated fire protection equipment

• Developing a thorough understanding and delivery of project requirements as they relate to scope, cost, and schedule

• Determining and expediting engineering deliverables for projects

• Developing and maintaining project scope of work documentation and revisions as required during design evolution

• Ensuring compliance with applicable fire protection codes and standards, including NFPA, IBC, and IFC

• Preparing technical documentation required for project execution, including design criteria, calculations, specifications, and equipment data sheets

• Reviewing shop drawings and submittals for compliance with design intent

• Producing coordinated models and drawings using BIM and CAD tools

• Coordinating sprinkler systems with architectural, structural, mechanical, and electrical disciplines

• Performing occasional site visits to support construction progress (valid U.S. work visa considered an asset but not required)

Qualifications & Experience

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (fire protection, mechanical, or related field)

• At least 4-5 years of experience in fire sprinkler/fire protection design

• Proven expertise in the design of fire sprinkler and suppression systems

• Strong understanding of wet, dry, pre-action, and deluge sprinkler systems

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Beacon Funding is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to test existing and new applications across our technology ecosystem, spanning internal systems (origination, underwriting, servicing, and portfolio management) and customer- and dealer-facing portals. This role combines manual and automated testing to identify and isolate defects across both legacy and current platforms, and works as an embedded member of an Agile Scrum team to ensure quality is built into the development lifecycle rather than caught at the end of it. We're looking for someone who actively applies AI-assisted testing technologies - for test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent defect analysis - to increase coverage and reduce the manual maintenance burden on the automation suite.

Job Responsibilities

• Perform manual and automated testing on existing and new applications, including internal origination, underwriting, and servicing systems as well as customer- and dealer-facing portals.

• Design, execute, and maintain test cases and automated test scripts to validate functionality across legacy and current platforms.

• Analyze test data and results to identify defects, isolate root cause, and document technical issues clearly for engineering teams.

• Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to reproduce issues, clarify requirements, and validate fixes.

• Participate as an active member of an Agile Scrum team - sprint planning, backlog refinement, story review, and retrospectives - to build quality into the development process from the start.

• Develop and extend automated test coverage using a test automation framework.

• Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing techniques - including AI-generated test cases from requirements/user stories, self-healing test scripts, and intelligent test selection/prioritization - to expand automation coverage and cut maintenance overhead.

• Use AI-based tools to accelerate analysis of test results, logs, and failure patterns, surfacing likely root cause faster than manual triage alone.

• Track and manage defects through the team's bug-tracking system, providing clear reproduction steps, severity, and impact assessments.

• Support regression testing across releases affecting both internal tools and customer/dealer-facing applications.

• Identify bottlenecks in the QA process and swim lane, and recommend process, workflow, or tooling improvements to reduce backlog risk and manual dependency.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, quality assurance, or engineering emphasis or equivalent preferred

• 4-6 years of experience in software quality assurance, combining manual and automated testing.

• Experience testing web applications; comfort working across both legacy and modern platforms.

• Working knowledge of a test automation framework and scripting for automated tests.

• Strong aptitude and eagerness to adopt AI-assisted testing tools and techniques (e.g., AI-generated test cases, self-healing automation scripts, AI-driven test prioritization or log/anomaly analysis). This is an emerging space - a builder mindset and willingness to experiment matter more here than prior hands-on tenure with AI-specific tooling.

• Experience with a bug-tracking or test-management tool.

• Basic SQL skills for data validation.

• Experience working within Agile Scrum teams.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate root cause across multi-system workflows.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills for documenting defects and collaborating with a distributed team.

• Experience testing applications in financial services, lending, or equipment leasing is preferred.

• Exposure to API testing is preferred.

• Experience testing customer- or dealer-facing web portals is preferred.

• Parental Insurance Coverage

• Accident Policy

• Retirement Benefits (Provident Fund)

• Gratuity

description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry's SDKs instrument dozens of platforms and our ingest pipeline takes in billions of events every day. The Telemetry Experience team owns what happens next: the product surfaces and APIs where that telemetry turns into something a developer can actually debug with.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Telemetry Experience, you'll own that experience across the sentry.io http://sentry.io product - Python/Django and Postgres on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend. You'll work upstream with our SDK teams on what gets sent and with our ingest teams on how it arrives, then own the part customers actually touch: the APIs, the workflows, and the interfaces where it all lands. Your job is to make that feel native to every developer who uses it, whether they ship a backend service, a mobile app, or a game.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Own projects end to end. Take a problem from a rough customer complaint through scoping, design, implementation across the stack, rollout, and measurement. You'll write the design doc, cut the work into shippable pieces, and stay with it until the numbers move

- Work across the full stack of the Sentry monolith. React and TypeScript in the browser, Django and Postgres behind the API. Most projects here touch both, and the interesting decisions live at the seam

- Partner closely with SDK and ingest teams. Telemetry arrives exactly as the SDKs send it and as the pipeline shapes it. You'll shape those contracts together with the engineers who own them, rather than working around what shows up

- Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and other product engineers. You'll bring the technical perspective that makes a design better, explain constraints in terms of what they cost the user, and sweat the details other people skip: empty states, error messages, loading behavior, the edge case that only bites 2% of accounts

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- You'd rather own an outcome than a ticket. You take ambiguous problems, decide what to build, drive it across team boundaries, and follow through after launch. Nobody has to hand you a spec

- You're obsessed with making an experience smooth. Friction offends you. You notice the extra click, the confusing label, the query that takes 400ms too long - and you fix them instead of filing them

- You solve problems for customers, not for the codebase. Sentry's users are developers, so you can read their bug reports, sit in their tooling, and tell the difference between what they asked for and what they need

- You communicate well in writing. Working across SDK teams, ingest teams, product, and design in a distributed company means your docs, PR descriptions, and updates do a lot of the work

- You like being full-stack. You don't need a handoff to change an API and the component that calls it, and you enjoy holding the whole path from event payload to rendered pixel in your head

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of professional experience building and shipping full-stack web applications

- Strong experience with React and TypeScript, and with Python (Django or similar) backed by a relational database such as PostgreSQL - depth in one side and real competence in the other is fine

- A track record of driving non-trivial projects end to end, including the parts that require getting other teams to agree with you

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

- Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools to enhance productivity and code quality

BONUS POINTS

- Familiarity with the application monitoring and observability space

- Experience building developer-facing pr
